title: Add [NonDebuggable] to Cryptography Management encrypt/decrypt procedures
summary: The Cryptography Management system application now marks all encryption and decryption procedures with the NonDebuggable attribute to prevent AL debugger access to sensitive cleartext data.
key_points: Four procedures in Cryptography Management codeunits receive the NonDebuggable attribute
EncryptText, Encrypt, and Decrypt procedures are now protected from debugger inspection
Prevents extraction of cleartext input and return values when procedures return Text instead of SecretText
Maintains confidentiality of encrypted and decrypted data
Follows existing System Application conventions for attribute placement
quote: Added [NonDebuggable] to all four affected procedures
